arxiv-1711-00656.title: The Physical Properties of Galaxies with Unusually Red Mid-Infrared Colours
arxiv-1711-00656.creator: Guinevere Kauffmann
arxiv-1711-00656.description: Abstract The goal of this paper is to investigate the physical nature of galaxies in the redshift range 0.02 < z < 0.15 0.02<z<0.15 that have strong excess emission at mid-IR wavelengths and to determine whether they host a population of accreting black holes that cannot be identified using optical emission lines.

arxiv-2201-06576.title: Asymptotic Gaussianity via coalescence probabilities in the Hammond-Sheffield urn
arxiv-2201-06576.creator: Jan Lukas Igelbrink, Anton Wakolbinger
arxiv-2201-06576.description: Abstract . For the renormalised sums of the random ± 1 \pm 1 -colouring of the connected components of ℤ \mathbb{Z} generated by the coalescing renewal processes in the “power law Pólya’s urn” of Hammond and Sheffield [ HS13 ] we prove functional convergence towards fractional Brownian motion, closing a gap in the tightness argument of their paper.

arxiv-2206-00704.title: Emergence of Fermi’s Golden Rule
arxiv-2206-00704.creator: Tobias Micklitz, Alan Morningstar, Alexander Altland, David A. Huse
arxiv-2206-00704.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Tobias Micklitz, Alan Morningstar, Alexander Altland, David A. Huse. Fermi’s Golden Rule (FGR) applies in the limit where an initial quantum state is weakly coupled to a continuum of other final states overlapping its energy. Here we investigate what happens away from this limit, where the set of final states is discrete, with a nonzero mean level spacing; this question arises in a number of recently investigated many-body systems.

arxiv-2206-06579.title: Chiral SQUID-metamaterial waveguide for circuit-QED
arxiv-2206-06579.creator: Xin Wang, Ya-Fen Lin, Jia-Qi Li, Wen-Xiao Liu, Hong-Rong Li
arxiv-2206-06579.description: Abstract Superconducting metamaterials, which are designed and fabricated with structured fundamental circuit elements, have motivated recent developments of exploring unconventional quantum phenomena in circuit quantum electrodynamics (circuit-QED). We propose a method to engineer 1D Josephson metamaterial as a chiral waveguide by considering a programmed spatiotemporal modulation on its effective impedance.

arxiv-2212-10588.title: Coherent backscattering in the topological Hall effect Journal: Materials for Quantum Technology
arxiv-2212-10588.creator: Hong Liu, Rhonald Burgos Atencia, Nikhil Medhekar, Dimitrie Culcer
arxiv-2212-10588.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Hong Liu, Rhonald Burgos Atencia, Nikhil Medhekar, Dimitrie Culcer. The mutual interplay between electron transport and magnetism has attracted considerable attention in recent years, primarily motivated by strategies to manipulate magnetic degrees of freedom electrically, such as spin-orbit torques and domain wall motion.

arxiv-2305-06209.title: Equality of the Hilbert Hamiltonian and the canonical Hamiltonian for gauge theories in a static spacetime
arxiv-2305-06209.creator: H. Arthur Weldon
arxiv-2305-06209.description: Abstract The Hilbert energy-momentum tensor for gauge-fixed non-Abelian gauge theories, defined by the variational derivative of the action with respect to the space-time metric, is a tensor under general coordinate transformations, symmetric in its indices, and BRST invariant. The canonical energy-momentum tensor has none of these properties but the canonical Hamiltonian does correctly generate the time dependence of the fields.

arxiv-2402-11094.title: Revisiting Word Embeddings in the LLM Era
arxiv-2402-11094.creator: Yash Mahajan, Matthew Freestone, Naman Bansal, Sathyanarayanan Aakur, Santu Karmaker
arxiv-2402-11094.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown remarkable advancement in various NLP tasks. As such, a popular trend has emerged lately where NLP researchers extract word/sentence/document embeddings from these large decoder-only models and use them for various inference tasks with promising results.

arxiv-2404-09835.title: Hardness of Packing, Covering and Partitioning Simple Polygons with Unit Squares
arxiv-2404-09835.creator: Mikkel Abrahamsen, Jack Stade
arxiv-2404-09835.description: Abstract We show that packing axis-aligned unit squares into a simple polygon P P is NP-hard, even when P P is an orthogonal and orthogonally convex polygon with half-integer coordinates. It has been known since the early 80s that packing unit squares into a polygon with holes is NP-hard [Fowler, Paterson, Tanimoto, Inf. Process. Lett.

arxiv-2405-00165.title: Solvable Initial Value Problems Ruled by Discontinuous Ordinary Differential Equations
arxiv-2405-00165.creator: Olivier Bournez, Riccardo Gozzi
arxiv-2405-00165.description: Abstract We study initial value problems having dynamics ruled by discontinuous ordinary differential equations with the property of possessing a unique solution. We identify a precise class of such systems that we call solvable intitial value problems and we prove that for this class of problems the unique solution can always be obtained analytically via transfinite recursion.

arxiv-2407-08369.title: Electric toroidal dipole order and hidden spin polarization in ferroaxial materials
arxiv-2407-08369.creator: Sayantika Bhowal, Nicola A. Spaldin
arxiv-2407-08369.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sayantika Bhowal, Nicola A. Spaldin. We investigate the role of electric toroidal dipoles in the prototypical ferroaxial materials NiTiO 3 and K 2 Zr(PO 4 ) 2 , which undergo ferroaxial structural phase transitions of order-disorder and displacive type, respectively. Using first-principles electronic structure theory, we compute the evolution across the ferroaxial transitions of the local electric toroidal dipole moments, defined both in terms of the vortices formed by local dipoles, as well as as the cross product of orbital and spin angular momenta.

arxiv-2503-03798.title: Graphical Stabilizer Decompositions for Multi-Control Toffoli Gate Dense Quantum Circuits
arxiv-2503-03798.creator: Maturitätsarbeit
arxiv-2503-03798.description: Abstract \pagelayout wide Abstract In this thesis, we study concepts in quantum computing using graphical languages, specifically using the ZX-calculus. The core of the research revolves around (graphical) stabilizer decompositions. The first major focus is on the decomposition of non-stabilizer states created from star edges. We discuss previous results and then present novel decompositions that yield a theoretical improvement.

arxiv-2506-17242.title: Differentiable neural network representation of multi-well, locally-convex potentials
arxiv-2506-17242.creator: Reese E. Jones, Adrian Buganza Tepole, Jan N. Fuhg
arxiv-2506-17242.description: Abstract Multi-well potentials are ubiquitous in science, modeling phenomena such as phase transitions, dynamic instabilities, and multimodal behavior across physics, chemistry, and biology. In contrast to non-smooth minimum-of-mixture representations, we propose a differentiable and convex formulation based on a log-sum-exponential (LSE) mixture of input convex neural network (ICNN) modes.

arxiv-2512-19618.title: Energy bounds and ergoregion instability in Einstein-Maxwell-Scalar field models
arxiv-2512-19618.creator: Filipe C. Mena, João M. Oliveira
arxiv-2512-19618.description: Abstract We investigate energy bounds and the stability of stationary asymptotically flat spacetimes with an ergoregion and no future horizon in the context of Einstein-Maxwell-Scalar field models which naturally arise in Kaluza-Klein and String theories. In order to do that we consider scalar field perturbations non-minimally coupled to a background electromagnetic field.

pmc-10748279.title: Effects of Different Die Metals on the Performance and Friction and Wear of Composite Materials during the Extrusion Process
pmc-10748279.creator: Hong Liu, Chuansheng Wang, Jean-Marie Raquez, Andrea Sorrentino
pmc-10748279.description: Extrusion technology is widely utilized in the rubber processing industry, with the extruder serving as the core equipment. As mixed rubber enters the extruder, it undergoes conveyance and plasticization, ultimately forming specific shapes and dimensions upon extrusion. The extruder head is a crucial component, playing a key role in achieving the final product’s required size and shape.

pmc-11816320.title: Associations of paternal age with offspring under-five mortality and perinatal outcomes: a cohort study using claims data in Taiwan
pmc-11816320.creator: Shi-Heng Wang, Jian-Te Lee, Mei-Chen Lin, Chi-Shin Wu, Wesley K Thompson, Chun-Chieh Fan
pmc-11816320.description: BackgroundThe causal relationship between advanced paternal age and offspring health is unclear, owing to familial confounders. This study examined the association of paternal age with offspring’s under-five mortality and perinatal outcomes, using sibling comparison analyses to account for familial confounding factors.MethodsA nationwide birth cohort study was designed based on Taiwan’s single-payer compulsory National Health Insurance programme.

pmc-12682500.title: Impaired diastolic filling and adverse event risks in patients with ST-segment-elevation myocardial infarction: insights from four-dimensional flow magnetic resonance imaging
pmc-12682500.creator: Xin Liu, Bowen Zhang, Jifang He, Xiuqin Jia, Jiajia Zhang, Chen Zhang, Qi Yang
pmc-12682500.description: BackgroundIntra-cavity flow disorders have association with adverse cardiovascular events in patients with ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI). This study aims to explore the characteristics of four-dimensional flow (4D-Flow) and its relationship with the adverse event risk scores in patients with STEMI.MethodsForty patients with STEMI (38 males, mean age 54.35 years) and 20 healthy controls (18 males, mean age 50.

pmc-12714139.title: Decanoic acid extends lifespan and modulates metabolism in models of PLA2G6-associated neurodegeneration
pmc-12714139.creator: Biqin Zhang, Ella Dunn, Robin S B Williams, Stuart Snowden, Hrvoje Augustin
pmc-12714139.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). PLA2G6-associated neurodegeneration (PLAN) is a group of rare genetic disorders characterised by progressive neurodegeneration resulting from mutations in the PLA2G6 gene, encoding a calcium-independent phospholipase enzyme. Here, we have explored the effects of decanoic acid (DA), a medium-chain fatty acid, in the fruit fly Drosophila melanogaster models of PLAN and show that DA treatment significantly extends the lifespan, reduces bang sensitivity and improves resistance to heat shock stress.

pmc-12930276.title: Elranatamab for Treatment of Multiple Myeloma With Central Nervous Involvement Refractory to Other Interventions
pmc-12930276.creator: Kelley Julian, Briana Peterson, Ghulam Rehman Mohyuddin
pmc-12930276.description: BackgroundPlasma cell leukemia and central nervous system involvement are two poor prognostic factors in myeloma, and such patients are often excluded from clinical trials.CaseA 59‐year‐old patient with primary plasma cell leukemia developed leptomeningeal CNS disease following autologous transplant. Intrathecal chemotherapy and selinexor, pomalidomide, and dexamethasone failed to clear cerebrospinal fluid plasma cells.InterventionElranatamab achieved complete serological and CNS response.

pmc-12936524.title: Nutritional deficits in paediatric extracorporeal membrane oxygenation patients: the impact of lipid-free parenteral nutrition on caloric intake and outcomes
pmc-12936524.creator: Mohammed Almutham, Manar Alawwad, Ibraheem Shammakhi, Samia Alhashim, Mohammad Alsharhan
pmc-12936524.description: Background and aimWhen extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO) was first introduced for paediatric patients, lipid emulsions were mostly administered directly into the ECMO circuit. However, clinicians have observed that lipid emulsions tend to separate and agglutinate within the circuit, raising concerns about potential complications.

pmc-13063780.title: How to alleviate the shortage: a scoping review of prevention and management of global drug shortages
pmc-13063780.creator: Qiusha Yi, Nan Yang, Linan Zeng, Liang Huang, Kun Zou, Jingjing Chen, Jiefeng Luo, Miao Zhang, Sha Diao, Qin Yu, Yizhun Zhu, Lu Han, Lingli Zhang
pmc-13063780.description: BackgroundDrug shortages have been reported to lead to insufficient treatment, delays or cancellations in care, poor medication adherence, prolonged hospital stays, increased medication errors, adverse events related to alternative therapies, and even deaths, posing a serious threat to public health. Despite ongoing and substantial efforts to address this issue, many drug shortages continue to persist.

pmc-13096511.title: Cyclophilin A stabilizes the capsid protein p72 to facilitate African swine fever virus replication
pmc-13096511.creator: Hui Kong, Liqin Yang, Zhenjiang Zhang, Ying Zhang, Linlin Liu, Wan Wang, Linfei Song, Yuanmao Zhu, Encheng Sun, Fang Li, Zhigao Bu, Xiangpeng Sheng, Dongming Zhao
pmc-13096511.description: African swine fever virus (ASFV) is a large DNA virus that poses a major threat to the global swine industry. Its virion is encapsulated by an icosahedral capsid predominantly composed of the structural protein p72, which constitutes approximately one-third of the total virion mass. Despite its abundance, the mechanisms regulating p72 stability remain poorly understood.

pmc-13126032.title: Reimagining resuscitation ethics: a narrative review and emergent ethical pathways model
pmc-13126032.creator: Saeed Khayat Kakhki, Majid Daneshfar, Alireza NamaeiQasemnia, Mehrdad Yousefnezhad, Sara Kazemi
pmc-13126032.description: Highlights•CPR ethics problems are structurally produced, not isolated bedside dilemmas.•Futile and symbolic CPR recurs under legal, family and hierarchical pressures.•Ambiguous DNR/DNAR pathways drive unwanted CPR and clinician moral distress.•The Ethical Pathways Model links contextual, relational and individual determinants.•Ethics support, clear policies and better communication can reduce conflicted CPR. Introduction Resuscitation occupies a uniquely complex ethical space in contemporary healthcare.

pmc-13187103.title: Electronic Blockade of Shunting Pathways via Dual Insulator Contacts for High-Efficiency Wide-Bandgap Perovskite Indoor Photovoltaics
pmc-13187103.creator: Quanxi Liu, Yousheng Wang, Qiaoyan Ma, Jianzha Zheng, Yinghui Peng, Liwei Wang, Zeyu Chen, Tianhao Du, Daxin Xiao, Jiandong Fan, Yoon-Bong Hahn, Yaohua Mai
pmc-13187103.description: Highlights Dual insulator contacts integrating poly(methyl methacrylate) (PMMA)-based grain-boundary passivation and a hybrid PMMA/mesoporous alumina ultrathin composite buried-interface layer.Dual insulator contacts suppress shunting paths and nonradiative recombination in both the wide-band gap (WBG)-perovskite bulk and heterointerfaces.The WBG-Perovskite indoor photovoltaics deliver a power conversion efficiency (i) of 44.36% (power output: 127.94 µW cm−2), with a high open-circuit voltage of 1.

pmc-13319793.title: Diabetes-type-specific thyroid safety of GLP-1 receptor agonists: evidence from a large real-world cohort
pmc-13319793.creator: Hao-I Hsieh, Yu-Nan Huang, Ya-Wen Chang, Wen-Ling Liao
pmc-13319793.description: Background:Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) are widely used across the glycemic spectrum, yet their thyroid safety profile remains debated. Prior studies have shown inconsistent findings, and evidence across prediabetes, type 1 diabetes (T1D), and type 2 diabetes (T2D) is lacking.Objectives:To evaluate diabetes-type-specific associations between GLP-1RA therapy and thyroid outcomes, including thyroid dysfunction, autoimmune thyroiditis, nontoxic goiter, and thyroid cancer.

pmc-13402495.title: Maternal nutritional knowledge and child anthropometric outcomes in preschool children: A cross-sectional study
pmc-13402495.creator: Sebahat Cam, Ozlem Kalaycik Sengul, Atila Kilic
pmc-13402495.description: OBJECTIVEThis study aimed to evaluate the nutritional knowledge levels of mothers of children aged 4–6 years attending pediatric outpatient clinics, analyze knowledge levels according to maternal age, education, and income, and investigate their relationship with children’s anthropometric measurements.METHODSThis cross-sectional study included 282 mothers of preschool-aged children who attended a pediatric outpatient clinic.

pmc-13631860.title: Spontaneous rupture and hemorrhage of a giant simple hepatic cyst in a 94-year-old woman: a case report
pmc-13631860.creator: Jingfeng Qiu, Changzhi Chen, Lin Li
pmc-13631860.description: BackgroundSpontaneous rupture and hemorrhage of a simple hepatic cyst is a rare but potentially life-threatening complication, particularly in elderly patients. Because its clinical and imaging findings may mimic other complex cystic liver lesions, timely diagnosis and appropriate intervention are essential.Case presentationA 94-year-old woman presented with chronic upper abdominal pain that suddenly worsened.

pmc-13656188.title: Matrix Metalloproteinase‐8 Deficiency Alters the Balance Between Viral Clearance and Immunopathology in H1N1 Infection
pmc-13656188.creator: Xiaoyun Wang, Joselyn Rojas‐Quintero, Duo Zhang, Joaquin Zuñiga, Caroline A. Owen
pmc-13656188.description: Matrix metalloproteinase‐8 (MMP‐8) regulates inflammatory responses, but its contributions to the pathogenesis of influenza A viral (IAV) disease are not known. Plasma MMP‐8 levels were increased 30‐fold in subjects infected with H1N1 or seasonal IAV and were inversely associated with the PaO2/FiO2 ratio, suggesting potential value as a candidate marker of lung injury severity that requires validation in larger cohorts.
